title: Monday banquets and bands he played with
summary: Society banquets in big halls each Monday; he played them with Jack Carey, Buddy Petit, Chris Kelly and others.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yeah. Do you remember you hear about the old dances too where they'd hire two bands like some of the society people maybe for a party I've heard of that. They have two bands there and they both play a few numbers and then they'll send one of them home pretty soon.

What band they like the best. What band the people likes the best they keep. Did they do that quite often they think? Well a lot of times it had been done. And then one time ago maybe Albert Walter will tell you the same thing I don't know if you remember. Every Monday we had things they call a banquet.
On Mondays. All the society, the many societies had banquets in high bands and had a lot to eat and a lot to drink.
Would that be in a home or some big hall?
No it was a big hall and all these big halls. Big halls of that.
Yeah all these big halls. Was that mostly for eating or for dancing or what was the main thing?
Well it was mostly for eating for society you know give the members eating and drinking and people dancing. A lot of people invited to come over and dance and have a nice time.
Do you remember some of the early dances like that? The bands that played some of those, do they call them sort of like banquets or how do they say some people call them banquets?
Banquets yeah banquets. We call them banquets. We used to call them banquets. But right there was banquets. Yeah. Yeah we used to call them banquets. Old Albert Glen every Monday we had one to play.
Yeah. Do you remember some of the bands that played those jobs? Some of the musicians you heard when you were young?

Oh yes. Yes. I remember a lot of those bands. They were old Jack Carey. I forgot to mention Jack my old friend. I did play with Jack Carey a couple of months before he taken sick and died. I played banquets with him. I played banquets with Buddy Petit. I played with Chris Kelly. Also with Kid René. Bill I played most every band in the city. Knowing band in the city. I really did. Played most every knowing band in the city. And good band.
